_doc: METRIC-LOOP-1 registry, read by foundation/metricloop.py every launch pass (foundation/sauce.py). Each metric: a reader with code (metricloop.READERS), a healthy condition (op, threshold), kind target or guard (a target gain while a guard worsens is a regression), an owner and ordered levers. A breach files Q-METRIC-<ID> with the first untried lever; a lever that did not move its metric by min_move_share of the gap within efficacy_days is retired and replaced; no lever left files Q-METRIC-<ID>-LEVER. Add a lever here to re-arm an exhausted metric. `python3 -m foundation metricloop --check` (checks.yml) validates this file.

metrics.why: Criticality: verified deploys per unit of cost plus human touches over 24 hours (foundation/criticality.py).

levers.action: Take the top raises-deploys item and ship it through deploy/deploy-workers.mjs so ops/deploys.jsonl gains a row with live_matches_commit true.
Turn an owner-held open item into a staged default with an automated acquisition attempt (CLOSED-LOOP-AXIOM), removing one human touch from the denominator.
Take the top cuts-cost item (Q-COST-*) and reduce rows read or neurons until ops/cost.jsonl reads under budget.

metrics.why: Latest cost reading over budget (foundation/cost.py); 1.0 is at budget.

levers.action: Find the largest D1 reader in the latest ops/cost.jsonl row and add the index or cache that removes its scan.
Route the largest AI caller to the cheapest capable model with a per-request fallback and automatic revert on empty replies.

metrics.why: Open queue items (docs/issues OL-* and Q-*); the queue must drain faster than it fills.

levers.action: Run `python3 -m foundation contracts --tick --apply` from the executor so every item whose closing probe passes closes in the same pass.
Give tickets about another record an **About:** line so foundation/metafold.py closes them when that record resolves.
Build the doer for the family with the largest open count in `python3 -m foundation throughput --report`.

metrics.why: Reopens over closes in 7 days (foundation/contracts.py); a close that does not stay closed is not a fix.

levers.action: Raise hold_minutes of closing-probe-contracts in doctrine/qnfo-port.json for items reopened three or more times.
Rewrite the closing probe of the most-reopened item so it measures its definition of done, not a file that exists either way.

metrics.why: Item families with net inflow, an open backlog and nothing closing them (foundation/throughput.py).

levers.action: Take the open Q-DOER-* items in queue order and build each family's closer.

metrics.why: Executor runs in 7 days that opened a pull request or verified a no-change, over all runs that attempted a change (ops/executor-log.jsonl on loop-evidence).

levers.action: Read the last failed executor rows, fix the shared cause (credential, prompt size, path guard) in foundation/executor.py.
Split the items the executor failed on twice into size S items with one file each.
